msDesc.head: A fragmentary manuscript of only ten leaves, of which the final is in the wrong position and should in fact be the first. Many of the enlarged initials, which were probably gold leaf, have been cut out, leaving lacunæ on the reverse.

msItem.title: 15 Os (Pseudo Birgitta)
msItem.rubric: [T]het war een hetherlig qwinne [...] swo som han frælste sancte pouel aff haffzens wode AmeN

msItem.title: 5 Sorrows of Mary
msItem.rubric: Her byries wor ffrwe sorgher et cetera
msItem.incipit: [-M-]Jn kiære Jomffrw Maria Jech beder tich for then første sorgh
msItem.explicit: til then ewærdelig glede ther aldrig kommer ændhe wppoo Amen

msItem.title: 7 Joys of Mary
msItem.rubric: Her byries Jomffrw Maria hennes gleder et cetera
msItem.incipit: [M]Jn kere Jomffrw sancta Maria wordhe thet tig till ære
msItem.explicit: ock kom mith maal i godh ænde i gutz naffn Amen *pater noster*

msItem.title: A prayer to Mary
msItem.rubric: Her børies een god bøn aff Jomffrw Mariæ
msItem.incipit: [-M-]Aria moder thw ther all barmhertighet kalles thw est the helge threfallighets benedide tempel
msItem.explicit: fræls mich aff all myn drøuelsse ther mith kan schade bode till liff oc till siel Amen

msItem.title: 10 Joys of Mary (Krongebet)
msItem.rubric: Uultu weten wo dit beth vp erden is gekomen [...]

msItem.title: 15 Joys of Anne
msItem.rubric: Hwo som thesse effterschreffne xv gwdelig læs [...]

item.desc: quaternion. originally a quinternion with the following bifolium
bifolium. originally the first and final leaves of a quinternion
